newsitem.title: USA: Anixter Int'l Q4 net down on sales slump.
newsitem.headline: Anixter Int'l Q4 net down on sales slump.

text.p: Anixter International Inc said Monday its results in the fourth quarter ended January 3 reflected a significant slow-down in orders from a major customer of it ANTEC subsidiary.

The company reported net income of $9.1 million, or $0.19 a share, compared to $10.0 million, or $0.19 a share one year ago. Anixter's equity earnings in ANTEC, in which Anixter owns a 19-percent stake, totaled $500,000, down from $900,000 in the corresponding period in 1995.
Anixter provides integrated cabling and computer network infrastructure equipment to businesses.
Its shares were trading down 7/16 Monday at 14-13/16.
